headline: Requests for a 110-unit apartment building at 270 Loudon Road and retail buildings at 282 Loudon Road.
summary: Other items include a new 8,160-square-foot building at 52 Locke Road and a commercial kennel at 85 Manchester Street. Sign requests at seven properties and a preliminary review of a 59-unit development on Sonoma Lane are also listed.
